name: touch
description: Look at a file or directory on the host without changing it. Text returns a byte range and a next offset; images and complete files return native content; a directory lists one level.

address.description: Path relative to the first configured root, or an absolute path inside any root.

offset.description: Byte offset for a text range. Must be 0 for images, complete files, and directories.

max_bytes.description: Maximum text bytes to return. Images, complete files, and directories ignore it.
